business_problem: The M&A teams at BDO need insight into the financial and operational data to get a holistic view of the company and its drivers—and they need it fast.
solution_summary: BDO Belgium, a leading accounting and advisory firm, found that its existing analytics solution for Merger and Acquisitions (M&A) reached its limits in terms of efficiency, scalability The M&A teams at BDO need insight into the financial and operational data to get a holistic view of the company and its drivers—and they need it fast. The M&A team found that its spreadsheet-driven approach to accounting and operational data limited the team's ability to make deep data connections, such as how a product launches or customer win could drive a company's valuation. Furthermore, Fabric can ingest and integrate large data sets using OneLake without requiring intense memory and processor on an on-site computer. The implementation centers on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Microsoft Teams to support real-time analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Provides the shared analytics foundation for ingesting, storing, and analyzing operational data.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and analytics views for operational and executive users.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

business_outcome: BDO Belgium, a leading accounting and advisory firm, found that its existing analytics solution for Merger and Acquisitions (M&A) reached its limits in terms of efficiency, scalability, and flexibility for providing a detailed picture of its customers' businesses. BDO developed a data analytics platform on Microsoft Fabric, named Data Eyes.
